description: This file defines a handler for listing team availability, including functions for fetching team members, building member data, and handling pagination and filtering within a team context in a scheduling application.

methods.name: getTeamMembers
methods.description: Fetches team members with enriched user profiles, supporting pagination and search filtering.

methods.name: buildMember
methods.description: Constructs detailed member data including availability date ranges based on schedules.

methods.name: getInfoForAllTeams
methods.description: Retrieves all team members across all teams the user belongs to, with total count for pagination.
